row_grain: one row per (trip_id, obs_index, arc_id) candidate
order: trips sorted by directory name; observations in input time order; candidates nearest-to-farthest within each observation

feature_definitions.cross_track_m: Metric distance from the GPS observation to the directed candidate arc.
feature_definitions.gps_step_m: Projected straight-line distance from the previous valid GPS observation to this observation; zero for the first observation.
feature_definitions.next_gps_step_m: Projected straight-line distance from this observation to the next valid GPS observation; zero for the final observation.
feature_definitions.time_gap_s: Positive timestamp difference from the previous valid observation; zero when unavailable or non-positive.
feature_definitions.gps_speed_mps: gps_step_m divided by time_gap_s; zero when the previous step has no positive time gap.
feature_definitions.arc_length_m: Projected straight-line length between the candidate arc's from-node and to-node.
feature_definitions.projection_fraction: Closest-point fraction along the directed arc, clamped to [0, 1]; 0 is the from-node and 1 is the to-node.
feature_definitions.heading_cos: Cosine of the wrapped angle from candidate-arc bearing to the incoming GPS heading.
feature_definitions.heading_sin: Sine of the wrapped angle from candidate-arc bearing to the incoming GPS heading.
feature_definitions.prev_heading_cos: Same value as heading_cos in the current implementation; retained for compatibility with Person 1 baseline models.
feature_definitions.next_heading_cos: Cosine of the wrapped angle from candidate-arc bearing to the outgoing GPS heading.
feature_definitions.prev_heading_available: 1 when a previous observation and positive timestamp gap provide an incoming heading; otherwise 0.
feature_definitions.next_heading_available: 1 when a next observation and positive timestamp gap provide an outgoing heading; otherwise 0.
feature_definitions.from_degree: Directed out-degree of the candidate arc's from-node.
feature_definitions.to_degree: Directed in-degree of the candidate arc's to-node.

target_format: boolean; True iff this candidate arc equals the route-to-GPS aligned target arc
candidate_miss_handling: Keep missed observations in validation to report candidate miss rate; exclude all candidate rows from missed observations during model fitting.
alignment: The ordered route arc sequence is spatially aligned to GPS observations with a soft route-progression penalty; it is not row-index matched.

partition_use.student_test: development evaluation only; do not fit on it
partition_use.evaluator_test: not exported or read by this command
